data.name: Mahlaa
data.gender_notes: Mahlaa is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'ahl' meaning 'people' and the root 'h-l-l' meaning 'to be tender, gentle, kind, and affectionate'. This name is often given to girls and signifies a sweet, tender, and gentle nature. The name Mahlaa carries the meaning “Tender, gentle, sweet” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Mahlaa usually hope their child will grow to embody tender, gentle, sweet and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the tender love and care of Allah SWT towards His creation.
data.etymology: Mahlaa belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Tender, gentle, sweet.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mahlaa total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

data.cultural_impact: The name Mahlaa is deeply ingrained in the Islamic culture as it reflects the compassionate and warm nature of the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him). He was known for his kindness and tenderness towards children, the elderly, and the poor. By bestowing this name upon a child, parents hope to instill qualities of kindness, affection, and compassion in their daughter, contributing to a more caring and loving society.
data.spiritual_significance: In Islamic spirituality, the name Mahlaa resonates with the concept of Ruh (spirit) and Rahmah (mercy). A gentle and compassionate soul is believed to be closer to Allah SWT, who in His infinite mercy sent the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) as a mercy to humanity. The name Mahlaa is a constant reminder of the importance of treating others with kindness, love, and compassion, for it is through these actions that we connect and come closer to Allah SWT.
